description: Transform Mohist from a deterministic workflow engine into an AI agent with its own LLM. Implement two-layer agent architecture (Workflow Agent + Sub-Agents), event-driven interaction, and workflow.yaml-driven pipeline.

tasks.title: Set up Vercel AI SDK v5 dependency
tasks.description: Add `ai`, `@ai-sdk/anthropic`, `@ai-sdk/openai`, and `zod` dependencies to packages/cli. Create a minimal LLM provider configuration in ~/.mohist/config.json and a provider loader module that reads the config and creates a model instance.
acceptanceCriteria: npm install succeeds without errors
Provider loader can create a model instance from config.json
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Start with Anthropic as the default provider. Follow opencode's provider config pattern.

tasks.title: Implement tool system
tasks.description: Create a tool definition API (similar to opencode's Tool.define) with Zod parameter validation, description, and execute function. Implement a ToolRegistry that registers and retrieves tools by ID.
acceptanceCriteria: Tool.define creates a tool with validated parameters
ToolRegistry registers and retrieves tools by ID
Invalid parameters return validation error
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep it simple: define(id, {description, parameters, execute}). No truncation needed initially.

tasks.title: Implement session management (messages)
tasks.description: Create SQLite tables for sessions and session_messages. Implement SessionManager with create, appendMessage, getMessages, and close operations. Messages have role (user/assistant/system) and content.
acceptanceCriteria: sessions and session_messages tables exist with correct schema
Session can be created with an issue_id
Messages can be appended and retrieved
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use the existing db/ infrastructure. Add migration for new tables.

tasks.title: Implement LLM tool loop
tasks.description: Create an agent loop function using Vercel AI SDK streamText() with maxSteps. The loop SHALL: build messages from session history, resolve tools from ToolRegistry, call streamText with tools, process tool calls (execute tools, feed results back), and return the final assistant text.
acceptanceCriteria: LLM loop calls tools and feeds results back automatically
Loop stops when LLM produces final text
Loop stops when maxSteps is reached
Tool results are returned as tool_call results to the LLM
tasks.notes: Reference opencode's SessionProcessor.process() and LLM.stream(). This is the core runtime.

tasks.title: Implement sub-agent spawning
tasks.description: Create a spawn_agent tool for the Main Agent. When called, it creates a new child session, runs the child agent's LLM loop to completion (synchronously waits), extracts the final text, and returns it as a tool result. Child agents SHALL NOT be able to spawn further sub-agents.
acceptanceCriteria: spawn_agent creates a child session and runs LLM loop
Parent waits synchronously for child to complete
Child's final text is returned as tool result
Child cannot call spawn_agent (tool not available)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow opencode's task tool pattern (task.ts). Child session is not persisted.

tasks.title: Implement basic Mohist tools (read, glob, grep)
tasks.description: Implement read_file, glob, and grep tools for sub-agents. read_file reads file content, glob finds files by pattern, grep searches file contents. These are read-only tools shared by Explore, Plan, Code, and Verify agents.
acceptanceCriteria: read_file returns file content
glob returns matching file paths
grep returns matching lines with file paths
Tools work within the issue's worktree directory
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Reference opencode's read.ts, glob.ts, grep.ts for implementation patterns. Simplify for Mohist's needs.

tasks.title: Implement write_file and bash tools
tasks.description: Implement write_file tool (write content to file) and bash tool (execute shell command with timeout). write_file is for Plan agent. bash is for Verify agent (run tests, git commands).
acceptanceCriteria: write_file creates/overwrites files in worktree
bash executes commands and returns stdout/stderr
bash has configurable timeout (default 5 min)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: bash tool should support cwd parameter for worktree scoping.

tasks.title: Implement call_opencode tool
tasks.description: Implement the call_opencode tool for Code Agent. It spawns an opencode subprocess in the issue's worktree, passes a prompt, waits for completion (with configurable timeout), and returns stdout/stderr/exit_code.
acceptanceCriteria: call_opencode spawns opencode subprocess in worktree
Prompt is passed via --message flag
Subprocess output is captured and returned
Timeout kills the subprocess after configured duration
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Reference current agent/runner.ts for spawn mechanism. Default timeout 30 min.

tasks.title: Implement event bus
tasks.description: Create an in-memory event bus with callback-based listeners (Set<listener>). Support publish(eventType, data), subscribe(eventType, callback), and unsubscribe(eventType, callback). All events SHALL carry an issueId field.
acceptanceCriteria: Events can be published and received by subscribers
Multiple subscribers receive the same event
Unsubscribe stops receiving events
Event data includes issueId
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Simple Set<listener> on globalThis or a module-level Map. No need for complex event routing.

tasks.title: Implement ask_user tool and pending map
tasks.description: Implement the ask_user tool using Deferred-based pending map (reference opencode Question module). ask_user creates a Deferred, stores in pending map, publishes question_asked event, and blocks until question_replied event resolves the Deferred. Also implement reject path (RejectedError).
acceptanceCriteria: ask_user blocks agent loop until user replies
question_asked event is published on ask
question_replied event resolves the Deferred
Question rejection returns RejectedError
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use Promise-based Deferred (Promise constructor with resolve/reject stored externally).

tasks.title: Implement workflow_log append-only table
tasks.description: Create workflow_log SQLite table and a log subscriber that auto-persists workflow events. The subscriber listens to the event bus and appends records for stage_enter, stage_exit, agent_spawn, agent_done, and human_action events.
acceptanceCriteria: workflow_log table exists with correct schema
Stage events are auto-recorded
Agent events are auto-recorded
Records are append-only (no update/delete)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Add database migration. The log subscriber is a simple bus subscriber.

tasks.title: Implement workflow.yaml loader
tasks.description: Create a WorkflowLoader that reads and validates .mohist/workflow.yaml from the project root. Parse stages with agent, description, expects, gate_after fields. Provide a built-in default workflow when no yaml exists.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowLoader reads .mohist/workflow.yaml
Stages are parsed in array order
gate_after values are validated (approve/auto)
Missing yaml falls back to built-in default
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use a YAML parser library (js-yaml). Validate with Zod schema.

tasks.title: Define sub-agent types (prompts and tool sets)
tasks.description: Create agent definitions for Explore, Plan, Code, and Verify agents in code. Each definition includes: name, system prompt, tool set (array of tool IDs), and optional model override. Explore: read-only + ask_user + add_comment. Plan: read + write. Code: read + call_opencode. Verify: read + bash.
acceptanceCriteria: Four agent definitions exist with correct tool sets
Explore agent has ask_user tool, others don't
Code agent has call_opencode, others don't
No agent has spawn_agent tool
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Agent definitions are TypeScript objects/modules. Prompts will be iterated on.

tasks.title: Implement Main Agent system prompt builder
tasks.description: Create a system prompt builder for the Main Agent that dynamically generates the prompt with: role definition, available tools, current issue context (title, description, stage), workflow definition (stages from yaml with descriptions and expects), gate semantics, and error handling guidelines.
acceptanceCriteria: System prompt includes current issue information
System prompt includes workflow stages from yaml
System prompt includes gate semantics
Prompt is dynamically generated per LLM call
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep prompt concise. Main Agent doesn't need coding knowledge.

tasks.title: Implement advance_stage tool
tasks.description: Create an advance_stage tool for the Main Agent. When called, it updates the issue's stage in the database, publishes stage_exit and stage_enter events on the bus, and returns success.
acceptanceCriteria: advance_stage updates issue stage in database
stage_exit event is published for current stage
stage_enter event is published for new stage
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is the Main Agent's primary tool for stage progression.

tasks.title: Implement add_comment tool
tasks.description: Create an add_comment tool for sub-agents to record findings and results to the issue. The tool appends a comment to the issue's comment list in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: add_comment appends a comment to the issue
Comment includes timestamp and content
Comments are queryable via API
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Reuse existing comment-repo from db/.

tasks.title: Implement Main Agent session lifecycle
tasks.description: Implement the Main Agent per-issue session lifecycle: create session on issue start, persist messages to SQLite, handle gate pauses (session remains in memory, LLM loop stops), resume on user action (inject user message, restart LLM loop), restore from SQLite on server restart, and close on issue completion.
acceptanceCriteria: Session is created when issue starts
Messages are persisted to SQLite
Session survives server restart (restored from DB)
Session is closed when issue reaches done
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Gate pause = stop LLM loop, keep session in memory. Resume = inject user message, restart loop.

tasks.title: Implement user message injection
tasks.description: Implement the mechanism for injecting user messages into the Main Agent session. When a user_message event arrives on the bus, append it as a user message to the session and trigger a new LLM loop iteration. Handle the case where the agent loop is already running (gate wait or sub-agent wait).
acceptanceCriteria: User message is appended to Main Agent session
New LLM loop iteration is triggered after message injection
Message injection works when agent is at a gate
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Need to handle concurrency: if LLM loop is blocked on a tool call, the message should be queued.

tasks.title: Implement mo attach CLI command
tasks.description: Implement the `mo attach <issue-id>` CLI command. It connects to the Mohist server, subscribes to events for the issue via SSE, renders agent outputs and questions to stdout, and sends user stdin input as user_message events. Support Ctrl+C to detach without affecting the agent.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo attach 42` connects to server and subscribes to issue events
Agent outputs are rendered to terminal
User input from stdin is sent as events
Ctrl+C detaches without stopping the agent
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: CLI is a thin client. Use SSE for event subscription, HTTP POST for user input.

tasks.title: Implement HTTP API for questions and events
tasks.description: Add REST endpoints: GET /api/questions (list pending), POST /api/questions/:id/reply (answer), POST /api/questions/:id/reject (dismiss), GET /api/issues/:id/events (SSE stream), POST /api/issues/:id/messages (inject user message).
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/questions returns pending questions
POST /api/questions/:id/reply resolves the Deferred
GET /api/issues/:id/events streams events via SSE
POST /api/issues/:id/messages injects user message
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Add routes to existing Express server in api/.

tasks.title: Remove old workflow engine and agent runner
tasks.description: Remove the deterministic workflow engine (workflow/engine.ts, workflow/issue-workflow.ts, workflow/stage-handlers.ts), agent runner (agent/runner.ts, agent/prompts.ts), hardcoded Stage enum from types/index.ts, and Task-related code. Clean up unused imports and references.
acceptanceCriteria: workflow/engine.ts is removed
workflow/issue-workflow.ts is removed
agent/runner.ts and agent/prompts.ts are removed
Hardcoded Stage enum is replaced with dynamic stages
No broken imports remain
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do this last after the new system is working. Keep git history for reference.

tasks.title: Implement rollback support
tasks.description: Implement user-initiated rollback in the Main Agent. When the user requests rollback (via command or free text), the Main Agent cancels the current sub-agent (AbortController), updates the issue stage, appends a rollback event to workflow_log, and spawns a new sub-agent for the target stage.
acceptanceCriteria: User rollback command cancels current sub-agent
Issue stage is updated to the rollback target
Rollback event is recorded in workflow_log
New sub-agent is spawned for the target stage
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Main Agent LLM interprets user intent for rollback. Keep existing artifacts (code/files).

tasks.title: Implement mo status with workflow log
tasks.description: Update the `mo status` command to derive progress from the workflow_log table. Display a timeline of events, current stage (from most recent stage_enter), sub-agent execution records, and duration stats.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo status 42` shows event timeline from workflow_log
Current stage is derived from latest stage_enter event
Sub-agent spawn/done pairs are shown
Duration stats are calculated from event timestamps
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Query workflow_log with `WHERE issue_id = ? ORDER BY timestamp`.
